explanation: The theorem is a dimension recursion for corners of the preprojective algebra of a quiver. It is proved from the library's own Koszul-complex maps (koszulSum, koszulDiff) together with rank-nullity (LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker). Mathlib has no preprojective algebra material; grepping "preprojective" (case-insensitive variants) in Mathlib returns nothing. The only generic Mathlib ingredient is rank-nullity, which gives just a step of the proof, not the statement.
